title: Austin Premium Driving Tour with Texas Capitol & Mt. Bonnell
includes: Texas State Capitol Building Tour (Admission Included)
Visit Mount Bonnell for panoramic views over the Colorado River
Complimentary Hotel pickup and drop-off from Downtown Austin
A famous Austin Taco (Included in Price)
Small-group experience (max. 7 guests) with a Local Guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Begin with a visit to Mount Bonnell, climbing 100 steps to one of the city’s most breathtaking viewpoints, offering panoramic views over the Colorado River and surrounding hill country.

Continue with a scenic drive past Lake Austin, where you’ll take in peaceful waterfront views and learn about the communities that line this beautiful stretch of water.

Cruise through South Congress Avenue, one of the city’s most vibrant districts, before stopping for a photo at the iconic Greetings from Austin Mural.

Enjoy a drive along Congress Avenue, taking in historic architecture and stunning views leading toward the heart of the city.

Your experience concludes with the highlight of the tour: a guided walkthrough of the Texas State Capitol (45–60 minutes). Explore one of the largest state capitol buildings in the U.S. 

Relax on the return journey as you’re comfortably dropped off back at your hotel.
